ex.en: The museum keeps a working steam locomotive from the last century.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存着一台上世纪还能运行的蒸汽机车。

words.note: loco 表地方、motive 表移动，即往返两地间的机车。

ex.en: Workers spent the whole week tiling the kitchen floor and walls.
ex.zh: 工人们花了一整周给厨房的地面和墙面贴瓷砖。

words.note: tile 作名词指瓷砖、瓦片，作动词指给…贴砖。

ex.en: The hospital received a large donation from a former patient.
ex.zh: 医院收到了一位老病人的大笔捐赠。

words.note: donation 可数，常与 make a donation to 搭配。

ex.en: The new bridge was built at immense cost to the local government.
ex.zh: 这座新桥让当地政府付出了巨大成本。

words.note: immense 强调体量或程度极大，比 huge 更正式；副词 immensely。

ex.en: There are risks inherent in any long-distance space mission.
ex.zh: 任何长距离太空任务都存在固有风险。

words.note: in 表内、here 表粘附，即内在固有的；常用 inherent in。

ex.en: Economic growth depends heavily on political stability in the region.
ex.zh: 经济增长在很大程度上取决于该地区的政治稳定。

words.note: stability 来自 stable；反义 instability 表示不稳定。

ex.en: We travelled across Europe on a tight budget and stayed in hostels.
ex.zh: 我们靠紧张的预算游遍欧洲，住在青年旅舍。

words.note: budget 可作名词和动词；on a tight budget 是常用表达。

ex.en: The old stove radiates enough heat to warm the whole room.
ex.zh: 这个旧火炉散发的热量足以让整个房间暖和起来。

words.note: radi 表光线、ate 动词后缀，即辐射；也指流露情感。

ex.en: Given that the roads were icy, the journey took much longer than expected.
ex.zh: 考虑到路面结冰，这次行程比预想的花了更多时间。

words.note: given that 引导原因状语，意为考虑到；given 也可作形容词。

ex.en: Thousands of animals perished in the forest fires last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，成千上万的动物在森林大火中丧生。

words.note: perish 是正式用语的死亡、毁灭；perishable 指易腐坏的。

ex.en: Fishing is a popular pastime among people living near the lake.
ex.zh: 钓鱼是住在湖边的人中很受欢迎的消遣。

words.note: pastime 是消遣，pass time 是两个词，意为打发时间。

ex.en: The ultimate goal of the project is to cut carbon emissions by half.
ex.zh: 该项目的最终目标是把碳排放减少一半。

words.note: ultim 表最后；副词 ultimately 意为最终、归根结底。

ex.en: It took the students several weeks to adapt to life on campus.
ex.zh: 学生们花了几周时间才适应校园生活。

words.note: adapt to 是适应，adapt from 是根据…改编；勿与 adopt 混。

ex.en: The company was prosecuted for dumping waste into the river.
ex.zh: 这家公司因向河里倾倒废物而被起诉。

words.note: prosecute 指刑事起诉；名词 prosecutor 是检察官。

ex.en: The first batch of new students arrived on campus last Monday.
ex.zh: 第一批新生上周一抵达校园。

words.note: batch 指同批生产或处理的一组，常与 of 连用；in batches 分批。

ex.en: Promotion here is based on merit rather than on years of service.
ex.zh: 这里的晋升依据是个人能力而非资历。

words.note: merit 作名词指优点、价值，作动词是值得，如 merit attention。

ex.en: They reached a verbal agreement, but nothing was put in writing.
ex.zh: 他们达成了口头协议，但没有留下书面记录。

words.note: verbal 指口头的，不等于 written；verbal abuse 意为辱骂。

ex.en: She asked her solicitor to check the contract before she signed it.
ex.zh: 她请律师在签字前检查一下合同。

words.note: solicitor 是英国的事务律师；出庭律师是 barrister。

ex.en: Learning driven by intrinsic motivation tends to last much longer.
ex.zh: 由内在动机驱动的学习往往能持续更久。

words.note: intrinsic 与 extrinsic（外在的）相对，多修饰 value。

ex.en: The house was chosen for its proximity to the railway station.
ex.zh: 选这套房子是因为它离火车站很近。

words.note: proximity 不可数，常用 in close proximity to 表紧邻。

ex.en: The hands of his watch are luminous, so he can read the time at night.
ex.zh: 他手表的指针是夜光的，所以夜里也能看时间。

words.note: lumin 表光、ous 形容词后缀；同根词 illuminate 照亮。

ex.en: The minister lashed out at reporters who questioned the new policy.
ex.zh: 部长猛烈抨击了质疑新政策的记者。

words.note: lash out at 意为突然怒斥；lash 本义是鞭打、捆紧。

ex.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
ex.zh: 保留收据，以备鞋子需要退货。

words.note: receipt 中 p 不发音；on receipt of 意为收到…就。

ex.en: Do not assume that everyone shares your opinion on this issue.
ex.zh: 不要以为每个人在这件事上都和你有相同看法。

words.note: assume 兼指假定和承担；名词 assumption，注意拼写。

ex.en: He believed his success was predestined and never doubted it for a moment.
ex.zh: 他相信自己的成功是命中注定的，从未有过一刻怀疑。

words.note: pre 表预先、destine 表注定；名词 predestination。

ex.en: The crowd chanted the team's name as the players walked onto the field.
ex.zh: 球员们走上球场时，人群反复高喊球队的名字。

words.note: chant 指有节奏地重复喊或唱；口号、经文都可用。

ex.en: She left the small town determined to control her own destiny.
ex.zh: 她离开小镇，决心掌握自己的命运。

words.note: destiny 与 fate 近义，常带注定成就的意味。

ex.en: The astronauts returned to Earth in a small capsule after six months.
ex.zh: 宇航员在六个月后乘小型太空舱返回地球。

words.note: capsule 指胶囊或密封舱；in capsule form 表以胶囊形式。

ex.en: The concept of shared bicycles spread quickly through major cities.
ex.zh: 共享单车的概念迅速传遍各大城市。

words.note: concept 指抽象概念，conception 多指构想、构思。

ex.en: This new type of rice is resistant to both drought and disease.
ex.zh: 这种新型水稻既抗旱又抗病。

words.note: resistant 后接 to；名词 resistance 表抵抗力。
